meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理 git 操作时会先判断你要提交、变基还是查历史;提交前检测仓库原有的提交风格与语言,自动把改动拆成多个原子提交,查历史则用 blame、bisect 等定位具体改动。
howto.when: 当你提到「commit」「rebase」「squash」等关键词,或想问某处改动是谁、何时加进来的,以及任何 git 操作请求时接管。

say.text: 把这些改动帮我拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先检测提交风格,再规划拆分

say.text: 用 rebase 把这个分支的历史整理干净
say.note: 会先判断分支状态再执行变基

say.text: 这个函数是谁写的?哪次提交加进来的?
say.note: 走历史检索模式,用 blame 等定位

howto.what_en: After install, Claude detects whether you want a commit, a rebase, or history lookup. For commits it reads the repo's style and language, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits; for history it uses blame and bisect.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you mention 'commit', 'rebase' or 'squash', ask who wrote or when something was added, or request any other git operation.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several atomic commits
say_en.note: detects style first, then plans the split

say_en.text: Clean up this branch's history with a rebase
Who wrote this function, and which commit added it?
say_en.note: runs history search with blame and bisect
